part0_determinism.note: The second row is a NEGATIVE CONTROL. If the full meter also reproduced, excluding wall_s/cpu_s would be unnecessary caution; a shortfall there is the evidence that the exclusion is load-bearing.

part1_population_structure_floor.reading: These are RANDOM segment players of the same shape. If the null median sits at the observed value, then class richness is a property of arbitrary programs under this observable, not a discovery about the population.

part2_discrimination_floor.alias_note: Padding was run under all three NOP aliases. A disagreement means the padding acted as DATA, so the size floor is a lower bound for that pair.

definitions.identity: meter(A) vs meter(A) -- sanity, must be 0.0
definitions.independent: meter(A) vs meter(A') unrelated, same size -- discrimination ceiling
definitions.order: meter(A+B) vs meter(B+A) -- can the observable see ORDER at all? A prerequisite for any A->B ordered-composition question
definitions.partner_identity: meter(A+B) vs meter(A+B') -- does it respond to WHICH partner, or merely to a second component being present?
definitions.size_floor: meter(A) vs meter(A + NOP padding) -- same behaviour, bigger program
definitions.size_matched: meter(A + NOP padding) vs meter(A + B) -- B beyond its length
definitions.treatment: meter(A) vs meter(A + B) -- what the experiment proposes to use

purpose: chance floor for the meter observable proposed by TODO T1; see T2
what_this_is_not: No specimen was selected, scored, ranked or interpreted. Every rate is over an arbitrary random ensemble. A rate is a property of the OBSERVABLE, not a capability claim about any player, and nothing here says composition does or does not produce synergy.
